name: The Trade Desk (TTD)
teaser: Revenue fell 0.5% but beat the company's own floor by $86 million. At $14.93 the stock sits 14.1% below my Base of $17.38; buy zone $9.99.
llms: The Trade Desk (TTD), listed on Nasdaq, runs the largest independent self-service platform for buying digital advertising and earns a fee on about $13.4 billion of annual ad spend; Amazon's cheaper buying platform and agency fee disputes pressure that fee. Valued with a ten-year free cash flow model with stock pay as a cost and a forward EV/EBIT cross-check on 2028. Third quarter 2026 revenue fell 0.5% to $736.0 million, $86 million above the company's own floor, and the fourth quarter guide is at least $755 million, down 10.8%. Bear $8.64, Base $17.38, Bull $29.59. Verdict Hold at $14.93 (November 9, 2026 Nasdaq close, before the results), maximum buy price $9.99.
